tool_schemas.name: read_file
tool_schemas.description: Reads a text file from the configured allowed directories and returns its contents, optionally limited to the first N lines (head) or last N lines (tail). It refuses requests with a missing path, a path outside the allowed directories, or a path that does not resolve to a readable text file. If head or tail is provided, it refuses non-numeric or negative values, and may refuse requests that specify both when it cannot satisfy both constraints at once.

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file

tool_schemas.name: read_text_file
tool_schemas.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file. Use the 'head' parameter to read only the first N lines of a file, or the 'tail' parameter to read only the last N lines of a file. Operates on the file as text regardless of extension. Only works within allowed directories.

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file

tool_schemas.name: read_media_file
tool_schemas.description: Reads an image or audio file from the configured allowed directories and returns its MIME type plus the file data as base64. It refuses requests with a missing path, a path outside the allowed directories, or a path that is not a supported readable media file. It also refuses when the target does not exist or cannot be opened due to permissions.

tool_schemas.name: read_multiple_files
tool_schemas.description: Reads multiple files in one call and returns each file’s content alongside the path you requested, while reporting failures per path without aborting the whole batch. It refuses requests with a missing or empty paths list, with any path outside the allowed directories, or with invalid path values. Individual entries are refused when a given path does not exist, is a directory, or is not readable.

tool_schemas.name: write_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates a file or overwrites an existing file at the given path (within the configured allowed directories) with the provided text content, and returns confirmation of what was written. It refuses requests with a missing path or content, a path outside the allowed directories, or a path that points to a directory. It also refuses when the destination cannot be created or overwritten due to permissions or missing parent directories.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0526000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0526000") else "/app/database")
def write_file(path, content=None):
    import os
    root = os.path.join(_DB, "workspace")
    p = str(path) if path else "newfile.txt"
    target = p if p.startswith(_DB) else os.path.join(root, p.lstrip("/"))
    return "Successfully wrote " + str(len(content or "")) + " bytes to " + target

tool_schemas.name: edit_file
tool_schemas.description: Applies a sequence of line-based replacements to a text file by matching each edit’s oldText exactly and replacing it with newText, and returns a diff of the proposed or applied changes (dryRun previews without writing). It refuses requests with a missing path, missing edits, or a path outside the allowed directories, and it requires the target to be a readable text file. It also refuses edits where an oldText match cannot be found exactly (or is ambiguous when the operation requires a unique match), and refuses writing when dryRun is false but the file is not writable.

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

oldText.description: Text to search for - must match exactly

tool_schemas.name: create_directory
tool_schemas.description: Creates the directory at the given path, including any missing parent directories, and returns confirmation that the directory exists after the call. It refuses requests with a missing path or a path outside the allowed directories. It also refuses when the path already exists as a file, or when the directory cannot be created due to permissions or invalid path components.

tool_schemas.name: list_directory
tool_schemas.description: Lists the immediate contents of a directory path within the configured allowed directories and returns entries distinguished as files vs directories. It refuses requests with a missing path, a path outside the allowed directories, or a path that is not an existing directory. It also refuses when the directory cannot be accessed due to permissions.

tool_schemas.name: list_directory_with_sizes
tool_schemas.description: Lists the immediate contents of a directory path and returns entries with their types and sizes, optionally sorted by name or size. It refuses requests with a missing path, a path outside the allowed directories, a path that is not an existing directory, or a sortBy value other than "name" or "size". It also refuses when it cannot access the directory or stat entries due to permissions.

sortBy.description: Sort entries by name or size

tool_schemas.name: directory_tree
tool_schemas.description: Builds and returns a recursive JSON tree of files and directories rooted at the provided path (directories include a children array; files do not). It refuses requests with a missing path, a path outside the allowed directories, or a path that does not exist. It also refuses when it cannot traverse the tree due to permissions or when the starting path cannot be read.

tool_schemas.name: move_file
tool_schemas.description: Move or rename files and directories. Can move files between directories and rename them in a single operation. If the destination exists, the operation will fail. Works across different directories and can be used for simple renaming within the same directory. Both source and destination must be within allowed directories.

tool_schemas.name: search_files
tool_schemas.description: Recursively searches from the given starting directory for files and directories whose names partially match the provided pattern (case-insensitive) and returns the full paths of matches, honoring any excludePatterns. It refuses requests with a missing path or pattern, a path outside the allowed directories, or a starting path that is not an accessible directory. It also refuses invalid excludePatterns values and stops traversing locations it cannot access due to permissions.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_info
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a single path and returns metadata about the file or directory, including type, size, timestamps, and permission information, without returning the file’s contents. It refuses requests where the path is missing, malformed, does not exist, or cannot be inspected due to insufficient permissions. It also refuses any path that is outside the server’s configured allowed directories (including attempts to escape them).

tool_schemas.name: list_allowed_directories
tool_schemas.description: Returns the configured set of base directories the service permits for file-system operations, which implicitly defines the accessible subtrees under each one. It refuses requests when the caller is not permitted to view the server’s access configuration. It also refuses to return paths that are not part of the current allowed-directory configuration.

metadata.name: StrataConfig Studio
metadata.description: A lightweight configuration and experiment-tracking service that manages controlled file access, feature rollouts, hyperparameter runs, and model training results through a secure filesystem API.
